A thank-you card that says it properly

Some people make life easier just by being around. When “thanks” in a chat does not feel like enough, send this: a thank-you card with a bouquet-bearing teddy that bows, a letter written out with all you want to say, and the photos that remind you both why it matters.

Make a thank-you card · ₹35

Preview it free. You only pay when you love it.

What’s in your thank-you card

  • A gift box that opens to your thank-you note
  • A handwritten-style letter in soft green stationery
  • Photos of moments you are grateful for
  • A teddy that bows and offers flowers
  • Warm sunbeams and a gentle music tune
  • A link you can send on WhatsApp in seconds

Message ideas you can borrow

I do not say it enough, so I am saying it properly this time. Thank you for always showing up, for listening and for caring.
Some people make life easier just by being around. You are one of them. Thank you for everything.
Thank you for believing in me before I did. It changed more than you know.

How it works

  1. Pick the moment and write your words. Add their name, your name, your message, and up to 5 photos if you like.
  2. Preview it for free. Watch the whole card, with sound, as many times as you want.
  3. Pay ₹35 and send the link. Pay with UPI, card, netbanking or wallet, then send the link on WhatsApp.

Questions

Who is a thank-you card good for?

Teachers, mentors, parents, friends, doctors, team mates, anyone who helped you.

Can I send it to more than one person?

The link can be forwarded, so yes. Each card is one link.

What do I need to make it?

Just the names, your message, and any photos you want to add. Everything else is filled in for you.
